stage: NR path: OpenMP blocker removed, heap blocker removed and verified numerically

openmp.why: the graph pipeline lowered scf with convert-scf-to-openmp, pulling in a libomp runtime (__kmpc_*) that bare-metal NR does not have; the handwritten NR operator pipeline lowers scf to cf instead
openmp.default_preserved: host lowering keeps enable_openmp=True, so the host JIT behaviour is unchanged

heap_blocker.statement: the compiled graph still allocates; on bare-metal NR there is no heap

uncovered_patterns.reason: no built f32 linear case for M=16 N=151936 K=1024

root_cause.what_it_is: an out-of-place materialisation of the TRANSPOSED lm_head weight (memref<1024x151936xf32>, seen as %alloc_157 right after one-shot-bufferize)
root_cause.why: prefill's lm_head is M=16, the one pattern the replacement leaves uncovered, so that matmul keeps its permuted weight operand and bufferization materialises the transpose

ab_experiment.decode: 8.3 MiB total, largest 4.0 MiB (no uncovered pattern; its lm_head is M=1 and IS covered)
ab_experiment.conclusion: covering that one pattern removes ~593 MiB per call; the A/B differs only in which patterns matched

secondary.kv_cache_copies: bufferization also copies both KV cache arguments into fresh static-layout allocations (memref.copy %arg16 -> %alloc_86, 1x8x512x128 f32 = 2 MiB each, four copies) because the argument has a dynamic-offset strided layout

fix_options.option: slice the prefill hidden state to the last token before lm_head
fix_options.effect: lm_head becomes M=1, matches the existing matmul_1x151936x1024_f32, and generation only needs the last position anyway
fix_options.cost: changes the prefill graph output from [1,16,151936] to [1,1,151936]; the FP32 reference comparison must then use prefill_logits[0,-1]
16x the lm_head work for positions generation never reads

fix_implemented.what: rewrite_lm_head_last_token in tools/triton_call_replace.py slices the prefill hidden state to its last position before lm_head, so it becomes an ordinary M=1 linear covered by matmul_1x151936x1024_f32
fix_implemented.how_lm_head_is_identified: semantically: the matmul whose right operand is a view of the same weight placeholder the embedding reads (the checkpoint ties them). A shape rule would also match q_proj, whose output width equals its weight's first dimension
fix_implemented.shape_propagation: the matmul's tensor_meta and the consuming ViewOp's args and tensor_meta are both updated; updating only tensor_meta fails with 'tosa.reshape cannot reshape 151936 elements into 2430976'

status: object builds with no OpenMP and 13.0 MiB of heap per prefill call; still not linkable as a bare-metal image -- see remaining_blockers
not_verified: no board run of the model graph

numeric_verification.comparison_note: sliced: the graph emits only the last position (last-token lm_head rewrite); the reference's last position is used

prefill 1-layer allocations 645,651,458 B -> 13,597,570 B; largest 622,329,920 B -> 4,194,368 B
